the inclusion of vitamin A intake in compartmental models of vitamin A kinetics can improve estimates of vitamin A total body stores and disposal rates in adults.

the inclusion of dietary intake of a nutrient in the compartmental analysis of kinetic data improves estimates of the total body stores and disposal rate of that nutrient, even when the data set is incomplete and/or of short duration.
